mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO sq_runtime_admission_counter ( pool_key, active_count ) VALUES ( #{poolKey}, 0 )
mapper.select: SELECT active_count FROM sq_runtime_admission_counter WHERE pool_key = #{poolKey} FOR UPDATE
SELECT user_id, binding_id, command_id, action, turn_id, status FROM sq_runtime_admission_slot WHERE binding_id = #{bindingId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sq_runtime_admission_slot ( binding_id, user_id, command_id, action, turn_id, status, acquired_at, released_at ) VALUES ( #{bindingId}, #{userId}, #{commandId}, #{action}, NULL, 'ACTIVE', UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), NULL )
mapper.update: UPDATE sq_runtime_admission_slot SET user_id = #{userId}, command_id = #{commandId}, action = #{action}, turn_id = NULL, status = 'ACTIVE', acquired_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), released_at = NULL WHERE binding_id = #{bindingId} AND status = 'RELEASED' AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT native_turn_id FROM sq_command WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND binding_id = #{bindingId} AND action IN ( 'SUBMIT', 'MESSAGE_SUBMIT', 'MASTER_SIGNAL', 'TASK_DIRECTIVE', 'RESUME' ) AND native_turn_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE sq_runtime_admission_counter SET active_count = active_count - 1 WHERE pool_key = #{poolKey} AND active_count > 0
